name: Starter: Punjabi
about: Gurmukhi Punjabi word order and agreement in everyday sentences.

words.ਹੋਣਾ: to be (ਹਾਂ, ਹੈਂ, ਹੈ, ਹੋ, ਹਨ; ਸੀ)
words.ਕੋਲ: near; used with a person to express having
words.ਤੁਹਾਡਾ: your (polite; agrees with what is owned)
words.ਚਾਹੀਦਾ: needed, wanted (agrees with the needed thing)
words.ਰਹਿਣਾ: to live, stay; used after a verb stem for an action in progress.
words.ਨੂੰ: to; on or at a stated time; marks an experiencer or a particular object
words.ਸ੍ਰੀ: honored, revered (in the greeting ਸਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਅਕਾਲ)
words.ਅਕਾਲ: the Timeless One (in the greeting ਸਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਅਕਾਲ)
words.ਨਾ: do not; not, in a request or command
words.ਦਾ: of, 's (ਦਾ, ਦੀ or ਦੇ, by what is owned)
words.ਨੇ: marks the doer of many completed transitive actions
words.ਪੈਣਾ: to fall; to rain in ਮੀਂਹ ਪੈਣਾ

sat-sri-akaal.about: Literally truth is the Timeless One; the standard Punjabi greeting.

tusi-kiven-ho.about: Literally you how are; a polite question to one person or a question to several.

kirpa-karke.about: Literally by doing a kindness; it makes a request explicitly polite.

kinne-da.about: Literally of how much; used to ask the price of a masculine thing.

maaf-karna.about: Literally forgive; used to get attention or apologize.

concept.line: ਹੋਣਾ changes with the subject: ਮੈਂ ਹਾਂ, ਤੂੰ ਹੈਂ, ਉਹ ਹੈ, ਤੁਸੀਂ ਹੋ, ਅਸੀਂ ਹਾਂ and ਉਹ ਹਨ.
ਤੂੰ is intimate singular and takes ਹੈਂ.

words.means: ਮੇਰੀ = my; ਮੇਰੇ = my; ਮੇਰਾ = my

concept.line: Nouns are masculine or feminine, and many adjectives and verb forms agree with them: ਛੋਟਾ ਕਮਰਾ, ਵੱਡੀ ਰਸੋਈ; ਉਹ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ or ਰਹਿੰਦੀ ਹੈ.
ਦਾ, ਦੀ and ਦੇ agree with the thing owned: ਮੁੰਡੇ ਦਾ ਬੈਗ, ਮਾਂ ਦੀ ਚਾਹ.
In a plain Punjabi sentence, the object and place normally come before the verb: ਮੈਂ ਚਾਹ ਪੀਂਦਾ ਹਾਂ (I tea drink).

words.means: ਰਹਿੰਦਾ = live; ਰਹਿੰਦੇ = live; ਰਹਿੰਦੀ = lives
ਜਾਂਦਾ = go; ਜਾ = going; ਜਾਂਦੀ = goes
ਰਹੇ = to live/stay; also an auxiliary marking an action in progress

concept.line: For habits and general facts, use -ਦਾ, -ਦੀ or -ਦੇ, normally with ਹੋਣਾ: ਮੈਂ ਚਾਹ ਪੀਂਦਾ ਹਾਂ; ਬੱਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਸਰ ਨੂੰ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ.

words.means: ਜਾਣਾ = to go; ਜਾਵਾਂਗਾ = will go
